hints.title: Contribution of Each Character
hints.text: Instead of tallying substrings directly, measure the contribution of each character s[i] across all substrings containing it.

hints.title: Last Occurrence Tracking
hints.text: Character s[i] contributes 1 to any substring starting at index L <= i as long as s[i] did not appear between L and i.

hints.title: Dynamic State Transition
hints.text: Total substrings ending at index i gain new appeal equal to i - last_pos[s[i]], while retaining all previous appeals.

hints.title: Linear Contribution DP Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is bounded by 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating unique characters across all O(n^2) substrings takes O(n^3) or O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Map of size 26 stores last seen index of each letter.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates the transition where each new character contributes (i - last[ch]) to suffixes.
